newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE TROUNCE OTAGO WITH SEVEN-TRY HAUL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE TROUNCE OTAGO WITH SEVEN-TRY HAUL.

text.p: Seven converted tries by the Free State Cheetahs made for a comfortable 49-18 victory over the Otago Highlanders in their super 12 rugby union match on Sunday.
Free State kept their game simple and solid and came from behind to lead 21-15 at halftime with three quick tries, then crossed the Otago line four more times in the second half.
Prop Os du Randt, playing his best match of the season, scored once and was perhaps more deserving of the man-of-the-match award, which went to Highlanders' winger Jeff Wilson.
It was the three tries within five minutes in the first half that set up Free State's vital away win and the maximum five points they managed from the game.
Lock Braam Els, hooker Naka Drotske (two), winger Chris Badenhorst (two), flanker Andre Venter and du Randt scored the visitors' tries and first five-eighth Jannie de Beer converted all of them.
Simon Culhane kicked all the Highlanders' points from six penalties.

Culhane gave Otago the lead with two early penalties but it lasted only until the 19th minute when second rower Els drove over the line. De Beer converted the try and Free State were never behind again.
A minute later du Randt galloped 40 metres, smashed winger Pailate Fili out of the way and took three other defenders with him before allowing Drotske in for a try.
Three minutes later, a fine lineout take by Free States saw Drotske collect a pass and ram through defenders and over the line.
Culhane kicked three penalties to cut Free State's lead to 21-15 at halftime and then another 10 minutes after the interval.

But straight from kickoff the Free States backs attacked and right winger Badenhorst hoisted a kick high when he ran out of room, chased and dived on the ball for a touchdown. De Beer converted and Free States led 28-18.
Midfield back Brendan Venter cut through a gap and Johan Erasmas took a pass before setting up fellow flanker Andre Venter for Free State's fifth try, which de Beer converted.
Badenhorst scored his second try in the 29th minute of the second half and du Randt capped his fine match with Free State's final try from a quick tap-penalty.

Free State - Jorrie Kruger; Chris Badenhorst, Helgard Muller (captain), Brendan Venter, Stephen Brink; Jannie de Beer, Werner Swanepoel; Jaco Coetzee, Johan Erasmus, Andre Venter, Braam Els, Stuart Landman, Dougie Heymans, Naka Drotske, Os du Randt.

Otago - Matthew Carrington; Jeff Wilson, Romi Ropati, Pailate Fili, John Leslie; Simon Culhane, Stu Forster; Isitola Maka, Taine Randell (captain), Lio Falaniko, Simon Maling, Steve Gordon, Carl Hoeft, Anton Oliver, Kees Meeuws.
